plugins.name: bdd
plugins.description: Behaviour-Driven Development toolkit: turn a one-line requirement into Gherkin, review it as an HTML spec report, sketch the UI the features imply on a wireframe canvas before any code exists, scaffold cucumber with Playwright for web and Appium for mobile, plan the work as files on disk and drive it to green with outside-in TDD, run the suite with requirement coverage, derive flow maps from run screenshots, and generate DDL from Gherkin.
